def AutoDesign_Open_RobustOpt():
    import os
    import shutil
    from recurdyn import MTT2D
    from recurdyn import AutoDesign
    global model_document
    global model

    strRelativePath = os.getcwd()
    file = strRelativePath + "\\..\\..\\DevItem\\V9R4\\G363\\Sample_Robust.rdyn"
    newfile = strRelativePath + "\\..\\..\\DevItem\\V9R4\\G363\\Sample_Robust_copy.rdyn"
    shutil.copy(file, newfile)

    model_document = application.OpenModelDocument(newfile)
    model = model_document.Model

    subSystem = model.GetEntity("MTT2D1")
    if subSystem is not None:
        subSystem = ISubSystem(subSystem)
    mtt2D = subSystem.MTT2DSubSystem
    if mtt2D is not None:
        mtt2D = MTT2D.IMTT2DSubSystem(mtt2D)
    model_document.ChangeDataStorage(mtt2D)

    Autodesign = mtt2D.GeneralSubSystem.AutoDesignToolkit
    if Autodesign is not None:
        Autodesign = AutoDesign.IAutoDesignToolkit(Autodesign)
    optimization = AutoDesign.IADDesignRobustOptimization(Autodesign.RobustOptimization)

    DPcollection = AutoDesign.IADDesignParameterCollection(Autodesign.DesignParameterCollection)

    ARCollection = AutoDesign.IADAnalysisResponseCollection(Autodesign.AnalysisResponseCollection)

    AR1 = ARCollection[0]
    if AR1 is not None:
        AR1 = AutoDesign.IADAnalysisResponseBasic(AR1)
    AR2 = ARCollection[1]
    if AR2 is not None:
        AR2 = AutoDesign.IADAnalysisResponseBasic(AR2)

    # Design Variable
    DesignVariable = AutoDesign.IADDesignVariableRobustOptimization(optimization.DesignVariable)
    DVCollection = AutoDesign.IADDesignVariableValueRobustOptimizationCollection(
        DesignVariable.DesignVariableValueCollection)

    # PerformanceIndex
    PerformanceIndex = AutoDesign.IADPerformanceIndexRobustOptimization(optimization.PerformanceIndex)
    PICollection = AutoDesign.IADPerformanceIndexValueRobustOptimizationCollection(
        PerformanceIndex.PerformanceIndexValueCollection)

    # Optimization Control
    OptimizationControl = AutoDesign.IADRobustOptimizationControl(optimization.OptimizationControl)
    MetaModel = AutoDesign.IADMetaModel(OptimizationControl.MetaModel)

    ConvergenceTolerance = AutoDesign.IADConvergenceToleranceOptimization(OptimizationControl.ConvergenceTolerance)

    # Result Sheet
    ResultSheet = AutoDesign.IADResultSheetRobustOptimization(optimization.ResultSheet)
    result_AR1 = ResultSheet.AnalysisResponseResult(AR1)
    result_AR2 = ResultSheet.AnalysisResponseResult(AR2)
    result_Violation = ResultSheet.Violation()
    result_NormalizedObject = ResultSheet.NormalizedObject()
    result_ESTD = ResultSheet.EstimatedStandardDeviation()
    result_SSTD = ResultSheet.SampledStandardDeviation()

    robustIndex_user = ResultSheet.UserDefinedRobustIndex()
    robustIndex_Relaxed = ResultSheet.RelaxedRobustIndex()

    # SummarySheet
    SummarySheet = AutoDesign.IADSummarySheetRobustOptimization(optimization.SummarySheet)
    optimumDV = SummarySheet.OptimumDV()

    optimumAR = SummarySheet.OptimumAR()

    summary_SSTD = SummarySheet.SampledStandardDeviation()

def IModelSetting_CustomView_point():
    import os
    global ref_frame_1

    centerpt = [0, 0, 0]
    normalDirection = [0, 0, 0]
    secondaryDirection = [0, 0, 0]
    upDirection = [0, 0, 0]

    szPathName = os.getcwd()  # Full path of current ProcessNet dll
    view = ICustomView(model_document.ModelSetting.CustomView)

    ref_frame_1 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_1.SetOrigin(100, 200, 300)
    
    marker = IMarker(model.CreateMarker("Marker1", model.Ground, ref_frame_1))
    
    refMarker = IReferenceFrame(marker.RefFrame)
    centerpt[0] = refMarker.Origin.x
    centerpt[1] = refMarker.Origin.y
    centerpt[2] = refMarker.Origin.z

    normalDirection[0] = refMarker.PrimaryPoint.x - refMarker.Origin.x
    normalDirection[1] = refMarker.PrimaryPoint.y - refMarker.Origin.y
    normalDirection[2] = refMarker.PrimaryPoint.z - refMarker.Origin.z

    secondaryDirection[0] = refMarker.SecondaryPoint.x - refMarker.Origin.x
    secondaryDirection[1] = refMarker.SecondaryPoint.y - refMarker.Origin.y
    secondaryDirection[2] = refMarker.SecondaryPoint.z - refMarker.Origin.z

    upDirection[0] = normalDirection[1] * secondaryDirection[2] - normalDirection[2] * secondaryDirection[1]
    upDirection[1] = normalDirection[2] * secondaryDirection[0] - normalDirection[0] * secondaryDirection[2]
    upDirection[2] = normalDirection[0] * secondaryDirection[1] - normalDirection[1] * secondaryDirection[0]

    view.ZoomScale = 2.108449165
    view.SetViewCenterPoint(centerpt[0], centerpt[1], centerpt[2])
    view.SetViewNormalVector(normalDirection[0], normalDirection[1], normalDirection[2])
    view.SetViewUpVector(upDirection[0], upDirection[1], upDirection[2])

def IReferenceFrame():
    import math
    global ref_frame_1

    # create body
    ref_frame_1 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    body1 = IBody(model.CreateBodyBox("Body1", ref_frame_1, 100, 100, 100))

    # Setting origin
    refFrameBody1 = IReferenceFrame(body1.RefFrame)
    refFrameBody1.SetOrigin(100, 200, 300)

    # Verifying origin
    origin = [0, 0, 0]
    origin[0], origin[1], origin[2] = refFrameBody1.GetOrigin()

    # Setting primary and secondary points
    refFrameBody1.OrientationType = OrientationType.CartesianCoordinate
    refFrameBody1.SetPrimaryPoint(AxisType.PlusY, 111, 222, 333)
    refFrameBody1.SetSecondaryPoint(AxisType.MinusZ, -111, -222, -333)

    # Verifying primary and secondary points
    primarypt = [0, 0, 0]
    secondarypt = [0, 0, 0]
    primaryType, primarypt[0], primarypt[1], primarypt[2] = refFrameBody1.GetPrimaryPoint()
    primarypt[2] = refFrameBody1.GetPrimaryPoint()
    secondaryType, secondarypt[0], secondarypt[1], secondarypt[2] = refFrameBody1.GetSecondaryPoint()
    secondarypt[2] = refFrameBody1.GetSecondaryPoint()

    # Setting Euler angles with Radian Unit
    alpha = math.pi / 2
    beta = math.pi / 4
    gamma = math.pi / 8

    # refFrameBody1.OrientationType = OrientationType.EulerAngles

    # Verifying Euler angles
    eulerAngle = [0, 0, 0]
    eulerType, eulerAngle[0], eulerAngle[1], eulerAngle[2] = refFrameBody1.GetEulerAngle()
    eulerAngle[2] = refFrameBody1.GetEulerAngle()

    # Setting Euler angles with Degree Unit
    refFrameBody1.SetEulerAngleDegree(EulerAngle.EulerAngle_ZYX, 90, 45, 22.5)
    eulerType, eulerAngle[0], eulerAngle[1], eulerAngle[2] = refFrameBody1.GetEulerAngleDegree()
    eulerAngle[2] = refFrameBody1.GetEulerAngleDegree()

    # Property

    # create body

    # Setting origin

    refFrameBody2.Origin.y = -200
    refFrameBody2.Origin.z = -300
    refFrameBody2.UpdateOrientation()  # you should use this method when you change properties directly.

    # Verifying origin

    # Setting primary and secondary points
    refFrameBody2.OrientationType = OrientationType.CartesianCoordinate
    refFrameBody2.PrimaryPointType = AxisType.PlusY
    refFrameBody2.PrimaryPoint.x = -111
    refFrameBody2.PrimaryPoint.y = -222
    refFrameBody2.PrimaryPoint.z = -333
    refFrameBody2.SecondaryPointType = AxisType.MinusZ
    refFrameBody2.SecondaryPoint.x = 111
    refFrameBody2.SecondaryPoint.y = 222
    refFrameBody2.SecondaryPoint.z = 333
    refFrameBody2.UpdateOrientation()  # you should use this method when you change properties directly.

    # Verifying primary and secondary points

    # Setting Euler angles
    refFrameBody2.OrientationType = OrientationType.EulerAngles
    refFrameBody2.EulerAngle.Type = EulerAngle.EulerAngle_ZYX
    refFrameBody2.EulerAngle.Alpha.Value = math.pi

def IScenario2():
    import os
    global ref_frame_1
    global ref_frame_2

    ref_frame_1 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_1.SetOrigin(100, 0, 0)

    ref_frame_2 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_2.SetOrigin(0, 200, 0)

    bodyBox = IBody(model.CreateBodyBox("Box1", ref_frame_1, 200, 200, 100))
    forceSpring = IForceSpring(model.CreateForceSpring("Spring", bodyBox, model.Ground, ref_frame_1, ref_frame_2))

    # Different from IScenario, IScenario2 is applied to the subsystem directly.

    # IScenario2 doesn't need to use IScenarioAnalysisTool interface, just add the IScenario2 to the subsystem's scenario property.
    # After adding a scenario, it is stored in the subsystem.

    # IScenarioSimulationDynamic2 is derived from IScenario2 which is for Simulation Dynamic Scenario.

def IUtility_Measure():
    global ref_frame_1
    global ref_frame_2

    # Create Bodies
    ref_frame_1 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_2 = model_document.CreateReferenceFrame()
    ref_frame_1.SetOrigin(-200, 0, 0)
    ref_frame_2.SetOrigin(200, 0, 0)

    bodySphere = IBody(model.CreateBodySphere("Sphere", ref_frame_1, 100))
    bodyBox = IBody(model.CreateBodyBox("Box1", ref_frame_2, 100, 100, 100))

    utility = IUtility(model_document.Utility)
    measure = IMeasure(utility.Measure)
    # Measure Geometry Radius
    geoBase = bodySphere.GetEntity("Ellipsoid1")
    if geoBase is not None:
        geoBase = IGeometry(geoBase)
    dRadius = measure.CalculateRadiusWithGeometry(geoBase)
    application.PrintMessage(geoBase.Name + " Radius is " + str(dRadius))

    # Measure Mass of Bodies
    oTargetBodies = [bodySphere, bodyBox]
    massProperty = IMassProperty(measure.CalculateMass(oTargetBodies))

    application.PrintMessage(bodySphere.Name + " and " + bodyBox.Name + " Mass is " + str(massProperty.Mass))
    dMassCenterPoint = massProperty.PositionOfMassCenter
    strMassCenterPoint = str(dMassCenterPoint[0]) + ", " + str(dMassCenterPoint[0]) + ", " + \
                         str(dMassCenterPoint[0])
    application.PrintMessage(
        bodySphere.Name + " and " + bodyBox.Name + " Mass Center Point is " + strMassCenterPoint)

    # Measure Distance of two points
    ptFirst = [100, 0, 0]
    ptSecond = [200, 0, 0]

    dDistanceWithTwoPoints = measure.CalculateDistanceWithPoints(ptFirst, ptSecond)
    application.PrintMessage("Distance is " + str(dDistanceWithTwoPoints))

    # Measure Distance of two geometries
    geo1 = bodySphere.GetEntity("Ellipsoid1")
    if geo1 is not None:
        geo1 = IGeometry(geo1)
    geo2 = bodyBox.GetEntity("Box1")
    if geo2 is not None:
        geo2 = IGeometry(geo2)
    dDistanceTwoGeometry = measure.CalculateDistanceWithGeometries(geo1, geo2)
    application.PrintMessage(geo1.Name + " and " + geo2.Name + " Distance is " + str(dDistanceTwoGeometry))

    # Measure Angle(Degree) of three points
    pFirst = [100, 0, 0]
    pSecond = [200, 0, 0]
    pThird = [200, 100, 0]

    angleDegree = measure.CalculateAngleWithThreePointsInDegrees(pFirst, pSecond, pThird)
    application.PrintMessage("Angle is " + str(angleDegree))

    TraJoint1.UseMotion = True
    MCodition = MotionCondition(MotionCondition.MotionCondition_Displacement)
    TraJoint1.Motion.Condition = MCodition
    TraJoint1.Motion.Expression = Exp_Cyl_Length
    model_document.Redraw()
    model_document.UpdateDatabaseWindow()

    # Adjusting size, colors, and Motion Hydraulic subsystem Right_Cyl
    model_document.ChangeDataStorage(Right_Cyl)
    PV_Cyl_Radius_R = Right_Cyl.GetEntity("PV_Cyl_Radius")
    if PV_Cyl_Radius_R is not None:
        PV_Cyl_Radius_R = IParametricValue(PV_Cyl_Radius_R)
    PV_Rod_Radius_R = Right_Cyl.GetEntity("PV_Rod_Radius")
    if PV_Rod_Radius_R is not None:
        PV_Rod_Radius_R = IParametricValue(PV_Rod_Radius_R)
    PV_Cyl_Radius_R.Value = 60
    PV_Rod_Radius_R.Value = 30
    Body1_R = Right_Cyl.GetEntity("Body1")
    if Body1_R is not None:
        Body1_R = IBody(Body1_R)
    Body2_R = Right_Cyl.GetEntity("Body2")
    if Body2_R is not None:
        Body2_R = IBody(Body2_R)
    Body1_R.Graphic.Color = Color.rgb_to_bgr(Color.LightGray)
    Body2_R.Graphic.Color = Color.rgb_to_bgr(Color.Yellow)

    TraJoint1_R = Right_Cyl.GetEntity("TraJoint1")
    if TraJoint1_R is not None:
        TraJoint1_R = IJointTranslational(TraJoint1_R)
    nameEx1_R = "Exp_Cyl_Length"
    szExpression1_R = "STEP(TIME, 0.1, 0.0, 0.5, -100)"
    Exp_Cyl_Length_R = IExpression(Right_Cyl.CreateExpression(nameEx1_R, szExpression1_R))

    TraJoint1_R.UseMotion = True
    MCodition_R = MotionCondition(MotionCondition.MotionCondition_Displacement)
    TraJoint1_R.Motion.Condition = MCodition_R
    TraJoint1_R.Motion.Expression = Exp_Cyl_Length_R

    # Define Constraints
    model_document.ChangeDataStorage(model)
    Chassis = model.GetEntity("Chassis")
    if Chassis is not None:
        Chassis = IBody(Chassis)

    RevJoint1 = "RevJoint1"
    RevPt1 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    RevPt1.SetOrigin(-1460, 440, 650)
    Rev1 = IJointRevolute(model.CreateJointRevolute(RevJoint1, Chassis, Body2_R, RevPt1))

    RevJoint2 = "RevJoint2"
    RevPt2 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    RevPt2.SetOrigin(-1460, 440, -650)
    Rev2 = IJointRevolute(model.CreateJointRevolute(RevJoint2, Chassis, Body2, RevPt2))

    Spherical1 = "Spherical1"
    SphPt1 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    SphPt1.SetOrigin(-1775, -90, 650)
    SphericalJoint1 = IJointSpherical(model.CreateJointSpherical(Spherical1, Chassis, Right_Rail, SphPt1))

    Spherical2 = "Spherical2"
    SphPt2 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    SphPt2.SetOrigin(-1775, -90, -650)
    SphericalJoint2 = IJointSpherical(model.CreateJointSpherical(Spherical2, Chassis, Left_Rail, SphPt2))

    Spherical3 = "Spherical3"
    SphPt3 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    SphPt3.SetOrigin(-315, 260, 650)
    SphericalJoint3 = IJointSpherical(model.CreateJointSpherical(Spherical3, Body1_R, Right_Rail, SphPt3))

    Spherical4 = "Spherical4"
    SphPt4 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    SphPt4.SetOrigin(-315, 260, -650)
    SphericalJoint4 = IJointSpherical(model.CreateJointSpherical(Spherical4, Body1, Left_Rail, SphPt4))

    CMotion1 = "CMotion1"
    cmotion_pt1 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    cmotion_pt1.SetOrigin(885, -130, 0)
    cmotionjoint = IJointCartesianMotion(
        model.CreateJointCartesianMotion(CMotion1, Right_Rail, Blade, cmotion_pt1, cmotion_pt1))

    Bushing1 = "Bushing1"
    bushing_pt1 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    bushing_pt1.SetOrigin(659, -280, 650)
    bushingforce1 = IForceBushing(model.CreateForceBushing(Bushing1, Right_Rail, Blade, bushing_pt1))

    Bushing2 = "Bushing2"
    bushing_pt2 = IReferenceFrame(model_document.CreateReferenceFrame())
    bushing_pt2.SetOrigin(659, -280, -650)
    bushingforce2 = IForceBushing(model.CreateForceBushing(Bushing2, Left_Rail, Blade, bushing_pt2))

    cmotionjoint.Condition = CartesianMotionCondition.CartesianMotionCondition_Displacement
    cmotionjoint.CartesianMotionType = CartesianMotionType.RotationalZ
    cmotion1 = model.GetEntity("CMotion1")
    if cmotion1 is not None:
        cmotion1 = IJointCartesianMotion(cmotion1)
    contant_angle = "constant_angle_of_zero"
    szEx_const_angle = "0.0"
    exp_const_angle = IExpression(model.CreateExpression(contant_angle, szEx_const_angle))

    cmotionjoint.Expression = exp_const_angle
    model_document.Redraw()
    model_document.UpdateDatabaseWindow()

    # Save the model
    model_document.FileSave(strSaveFile, True)

    # Analysis
    model_document.ModelProperty.DynamicAnalysisProperty.SimulationStep.Value = 250
    model_document.ModelProperty.DynamicAnalysisProperty.SimulationTime.Value = 5
    model_document.ModelProperty.DynamicAnalysisProperty.PlotMultiplierStepFactor.Value = 8
    model_document.Analysis(AnalysisMode.Dynamic)

    # Draw a plot
    plot_document = model_document.CreatePlotDocument(PlotDocType.Empty)
    szPathRPLT = strRelativePath + "\\..\\..\\Tutorial\\Toolkit\\LowMobilityTrackedVehicle\\LowMobilityTrackedVehicle_Ch7_01\\LowMobilityTrackedVehicle_Ch7.rplt"
    plot_document.ImportPlotDataFile(szPathRPLT)
    arrTime = plot_document.GetPlotData("LowMobilityTrackedVehicle_Ch7/Time")
    bushingforce_right = plot_document.GetPlotData(
        "LowMobilityTrackedVehicle_Ch7/Track-Force/TrackLink2@Right_Track_Assy/BushingTension")
    plot_document.DrawPlot("BushingTension-TrackLink2", arrTime, bushingforce_right)

classes.name: IForceRotational
classes.description: The rotational force element generates three orthogonal rotational forces. This element applies action forces to the action marker and the corresponding reaction force is applied to the base marker.

classes.name: IForceScrew
classes.description: The screw force element generates three translation and three rotational forces. You can define these forces using a function expression or the user-defined subroutine SCREWSUB.

classes.name: IForceSpringRotational
classes.description: The rotational spring Force can be attached only to a revolute joint.

classes.name: IForceTranslational
classes.description: The translational force element generates three orthogonal translational forces. This element applies action forces to the action marker, and the corresponding reaction force is applied to the base marker.

classes.name: IJointAtpoint
classes.description: The ATPOINT elementary joint is the same as the spherical joint. This joint has three rotational degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointCartesianMotion
classes.description: The Cartesian motion(CMOTION) is the Cartesian driving constraint for a selected translational or rotational degree of freedom of a reference frame.

classes.name: IJointConstantVelocity
classes.description: The constant velocity constraint can model a constant velocity joint. This joint has two degrees of freedom. This joint is made constant velocity in the base body and the action body about the Z-axis of the joint marker.

classes.name: IJointCurveOnCurve
classes.description: The CVCV constraint can model a continuous contact model between two curves.

classes.name: IJointCylindrical
classes.description: The cylindrical joint allows one rotational degree of freedom and one translational degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointCylindricalFriction
classes.description: Cylindrical joint friction. The cylindrical joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointDistance
classes.description: The distance joint constrains the distance between two points defined on two bodies. This joint has five degrees of freedom.

classes.name: IJointFixed
classes.description: The fixed joint has zero degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointInCMotionGroup
classes.description: CMOTION joint in the group cmotion

classes.name: IJointInline
classes.description: The INLINE elementary joint constrains the origin of the action marker to lie on the z-axis of a base marker.

classes.name: IJointInplane
classes.description: The INPLANE elementary joint constrains the origin of the action marker to lie on the X-Y plane of the base marker.

classes.name: IJointInplaneFriction
classes.description: Inplane joint friction. The Inplane joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointOnOff
classes.description: The OnOffJoint controls the six degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointOrientation
classes.description: The ORIENTATION elementary joint constrains the orientation of the action marker to have the same orientation of the base marker. The resulting degrees of freedom are three.

classes.name: IJointParallel
classes.description: The PARALLEL AXES elementary joint constrains the z-axis of the action marker to be parallel to the z-axis of the base marker. The resulting degrees of freedom are four.

classes.name: IJointPerpendicular
classes.description: The PERPENDICULAR elementary joint constrains the z-axis of the action marker to be perpendicular to the z-axis of the base marker. The resulting degrees of freedom are five.

classes.name: IJointPlanar
classes.description: The planar joint allows one rotational and two translational degrees of freedom.

classes.name: IJointPlanarFriction
classes.description: Planar joint friction. The Planar joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointPointOnCurve
classes.description: The PTCV(Point on curve) constraint constrains one point of a body to lie on a spline curve defined on the other body. The spline curve must have been defined prior to creating the PTCV. This joint has five degrees of freedom.

classes.name: IJointRevolute
classes.description: The revolute joint allows one rotational degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointRevoluteFriction
classes.description: Revolute joint friction. The revolute joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointScrew
classes.description: The screw joint has one degree of freedom. The translation of Z-axis gets constraint by a pitch about rotational degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointScrewFriction
classes.description: Screw joint friction. The Screw joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointSpherical
classes.description: The spherical joint allows three rotational degrees of freedom.

classes.name: IJointSphericalFriction
classes.description: Spherical joint friction. The spherical joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointTranslational
classes.description: The translational joint allows one translational degree of freedom.

classes.name: IJointTranslationalFriction
classes.description: Translational joint friction. The translational joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IJointUniversal
classes.description: The universal joint allows two rotational degrees of freedom, namely the rotations about the two cross axes.

classes.name: IJointUniversalFriction
classes.description: Universal joint friction. The universal joint friction force which contains stiction algorithm.

classes.name: IPairConstraintCoupler
classes.description: The coupler can be used to relate relative coordinates of revolute, translational, and cylindrical joints. The relative coordinates may have a linear relationship, which is defined as scales.

classes.name: IPairConstraintGear
classes.description: You can use a gear constraint to relate relative coordinates of two revolute joints. You can define the gear ratio by attaching a common velocity marker on the carrier body to which the joints are attaches.

classes.name: ISweepOption
classes.description: Options used when creating sweep geometry
